description:
[read-only] Splits every labelled post by the values of one label key (e.g. key "cut" → cut:opus vs cut:raw) and reports medians with n per group at the 48h / 7d snapshot. Descriptive, not a significance test. Pro plan or higher.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/analytics/experiments.)

brandId.description: A brand id, or "all" (default: every profile you can see). A brand-bound key is always its own brand.

name: compare_labels
title: Compare posts by a label (A/B)
